
log "REPORT"
echo "Domain:         example.com"
echo "Mail host:      mail.example.com"
echo "PTR at your provider: 203.0.113.10 -> relay.example.com (critical for deliverability)."
echo "Backup passphrase (keep it — encrypted backups need it): $(cat /etc/gryonixnexus/autobackup.pass 2>/dev/null)"
echo
echo "Service status:"
for s in nftables docker caddy; do
  printf '  %-14s %s\n' "$s" "$(systemctl is-active "$s" || true)"
done
echo
echo "Remember the DNS records from dns-records.txt — without them Caddy cannot issue certificates."

echo
echo "=== SERVICE CREDENTIALS (save these) ==="
echo "Mailu:        https://mail.example.com/admin"
echo "  Webmail:     https://mail.example.com/webmail"
echo "  Administrator: admin@example.com"
echo "  Password (generated on the server): $(grep '^INITIAL_ADMIN_PW=' /opt/mailu/.env | cut -d= -f2-)"
# The DKIM records, straight from the engine that minted them. Not
# fatal and not silenced: a missing key is a DNS record the user
# adds later, not a reason to lose the rest of the report.
echo "  Mail clients: IMAP 993 and SMTP 465, both with TLS (ports 143 and 587 are not served)"
echo "  DKIM records (add them to DNS):"
/opt/gryonixnexus-mailu-dkim.sh 2>/dev/null | grep '^GRYONIXNEXUS_DKIM ' | while read -r _ NAME VALUE; do
  echo "    $NAME TXT $VALUE"
done || echo "    not ready yet — open Domains in the Mailu admin UI to see the DKIM record"
